# Operations review

## Observations

- Orders from the north depot are packed in a separate room.
- Payments that return an error code from the bank are 2.1% of card attempts and 0.4% of transfer attempts.
- Assuming two of the three carriers agree to scan at pickup, missing-parcel reports should fall by a quarter by June.
